errors.text_span: with tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.02
errors.evidence: The tick labels on the x-axis are not consistently spaced at intervals of 0.02. After the first tick at 0.86, the next is 0.88 (an interval of 0.02), but subsequent ticks are at intervals of 0.01 (0.89, 0.90, 0.91, etc.).

errors.text_span: rises to a peak near 0.90 at an initial confidence of 0.97
errors.evidence: The peak of the green line (Initial Accuracy) is not at an initial confidence of 0.97. The peak occurs at an initial confidence of 0.99, and its value is approximately 0.95, not 0.90.
The orange line (Δ Accuracy) begins at an initial confidence of 0.86 with an accuracy value closer to 0.28-0.29, not 0.25.
The description omits the line styles for each series: solid for 'Final Accuracy', dashed for 'Δ Accuracy', and dash-dot for 'Initial Accuracy'.
